integrity: Analytical proof and independently executed standard-library verification script; no independent external audit, no exhaustive literature-uniqueness certificate.
scientific_limitations: Two inverse-multiquadric sites, first-site Nyström landmark, exactly matched positive ridge, exact arithmetic. Direct-sum extension only for general SPD kernels. No probabilistic failure rate or floating-point guarantee; low-rank surrogate is not spectrally accurate near the sharp boundary.
title: A sharp Nyström–Rippa leave-one-out amplification and shape-gradient reversal
